name: CN_TP_CALC_SIMULATION_ALL
description: This table is used to store calculation simulation objects.

columns.name: SIMULATION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a calculation simulation.

columns.name: SIMULATION_NAME
columns.description: Optional user-friendly name to identify the calculation simulation. At the time the simulation is processed, the field IS_LATEST will be set to 'N' for all the existing simulations using the same name, while it will be set to 'Y' for the current calculation simulation.

columns.name: IS_LATEST_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether a simulation is the latest among all simulations processed which have the same SIMULATION_NAME value.

columns.name: SIMULATION_TYPE
columns.description: Defines the type of processing that needs to be used in this simulation.

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: The type of the source object used to generate this Calculation Simulation.

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: The identifier of the source object used to generate this Calculation Simulation.

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJECT_NUMBER
columns.description: Alternate identifier of the source object used to generate this Calculation Simulation.

columns.name: OWNER_ID
columns.description: The identifier of the Participant that owns this Calculation Simulation. Used to determine the users that have access to the results.

columns.name: PROCESSING_STATUS
columns.description: The status of the calculation simulation, used to know if the simulation is ready to be processed, is being processed, has completed, or has ended in error.

columns.name: PROCESSING_DATE
columns.description: The date when this calculation simulation was processed.

columns.name: ASYNC_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Indicates the request ID of the job used to execute the calculation simulation asynchronously.

columns.name: SIMULATION_START_PERIOD_ID
columns.description: The starting period id used for this calculation simulation. If null the period id would be automatically calculated.

columns.name: SIMULATION_END_PERIOD_ID
columns.description: The ending period id used for this calculation simulation. If null the period id would be automatically calculated.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: PROCESS_AUDIT_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to relate the processing logs stored in cn_process_audits_all table.

columns.name: ERROR_CODE
columns.description: When the calculation simulation ends in error status, this value indicates the error type.

columns.name: CURRENT_EARNINGS_SUM_CALC
columns.description: The sum of the earnings in calculation currency already earned by a participant before the calculation simulation.

columns.name: CURRENT_EARNINGS_SUM_HOME
columns.description: The sum of the earnings in home currency already earned by a participant before the calculation simulation.

columns.name: CURRENT_EARNINGS_SUM_FUNC
columns.description: The sum of the earnings in functional currency already earned by a participant before the calculation simulation.

columns.name: GAIN_SUM_CALC
columns.description: The sum of the gain in calculation currency calculated during the calculation simulation.

columns.name: GAIN_SUM_HOME
columns.description: The sum of the gain in home currency calculated during the calculation simulation.

columns.name: GAIN_SUM_FUNC
columns.description: The sum of the gain in functional currency calculated during the calculation simulation.

columns.name: CALC_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Calculation currency code.

columns.name: HOME_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Participant's home currency code

columns.name: START_PAY_PERIOD_ID
columns.description: The lowest pay period id for the earnings in this calculation simulation.

columns.name: END_PAY_PERIOD_ID
columns.description: The highest pay period id for the earnings in this calculation simulation.

columns.name: UPDATE_QUEUED
columns.description: Indicates there is a new simulation with the same name in queue to be processed.

columns.name: QUEUE_NUMBER
columns.description: Internal number used distribute the processing of queued simulations.

columns.name: BLOCKING_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the job that needs to complete to process this simulation.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
